_doc: Round-5 keyword-docs measurements (robotcode 2.7.0 subprocess, n=6 medians; in-process kwcache cold build / warm load / lookup)

syntax.library_args: robotcode libdoc 'Lib::arg1::name=value' show "<Kw>" (verified: ArgLib.py::advanced and ::mode=advanced::timeout=1s expose the mode-dependent keyword)
syntax.resource: robotcode libdoc path/x.resource show "<Kw>" (path relative to cwd)
syntax.wrong_name: show "Get Txt" -> rc 0, EMPTY output (silent); case-insensitive exact names work; globs work ("Get T*")
syntax.BuiltIn_json: --format JSON BuiltIn fails rc 252 ('Markdown format requires markdown module'); add --specdocformat RAW
syntax.repl_kw: .kw is substring search only: 'Clik', 'click element', 'wait visible' -> 'No keywords found matching'; exact name prints full markdown doc (~2.4 KB for Get Text)
